Looking at panel C, fraction (i) (orange) is dominated by cluster 1 (ventricular cardiomyocytes), while fraction (ii) (green) contains clusters 14, 7, and 5. Comparing the relative sizes of these clusters between the two fractions, cluster 7 (atrial cardiomyocytes) is only a minor component in (i) but forms a large, dense population in (ii). Thus cluster 7 is present in both but considerably more prevalent in (ii).

[ANSWER]B[/ANSWER]
